_doc: Page errors that are real but known and tracked elsewhere. drive.js logs them as 'known' instead of failing the run. Each entry: pattern (regex on the error line), why (where it is tracked). Remove an entry once fixed.

issues.why: avatars/ut/_s/index.json in core lists three roles whose source png lives only in a private local/ layer; the page HEAD-checks them and falls back. Found by t-oss-s2-tests; fix belongs to the avatar manifest (core/local split), not to the tests.
